decisions: Minutes from the August 10, 2025 board meeting approved as amended.
Pierre Dubois authorized to initiate a formal cost-containment audit across all departments, with findings due at the October board meeting; net profit margin target of 20% set for Q4 2025.
Marbledock & Associates will submit a comprehensive RFP response to Polestar Industries by October 3, 2025, led by Aiyana Park.
Recruitment for two senior consultant positions to support the Polestar Industries account to begin immediately, with a hiring deadline of November 1, 2025.
Margaret Holvan to schedule an executive meeting with Polestar Industries' Daniel Kroft before October 15, 2025, to advance multi-year contract extension discussions.
Option B modular upgrade of project management and CRM platforms approved; implementation target of November 30, 2025, overseen by Aiyana Park.
Aiyana Park to finalize and circulate revised workload balancing protocol by October 1, 2025; working group to be formed for a career progression and mentorship program targeting Q1 2026 launch.
Pierre Dubois to draft a Strategic Partnership Framework by November 1, 2025; Margaret Holvan to initiate exploratory conversations with identified law firms and financial advisory group.
